phase_name: Build plan-file-scope-harvest.sh with its test suite

objectives.description: Create plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, Class A strict mode
Document contract: one positional arg, JSON array stdout, non-zero reserved for usage errors
Accept both punctuation forms for block header
Entry detection, description stripping, continuation/prose tolerance, block-end detection
Create test-plan-file-scope-harvest.sh covering all grammar cases
Run suite and shellcheck both new files

deviations.description: Additional grammar wrinkle discovered at implementation time beyond the research report's three: a per-phase field (including Files to modify) may itself be rendered as a top-level list item (leading `- ` before the bold label, e.g. `- **Files to modify**:`), with its entries indented one level (`  - \`path\``). This is not a malformed plan -- plan-format.md's own compact example template already renders every field this way, and one real local plan (specs/207_fix_zotero_export_path1_truncation) uses it, which the harvester initially mis-parsed as an EMPTY result for that file's phases.
deviations.reason: Widened the harvester's header/entry/field-label-terminator regexes to tolerate an optional single leading list marker (via a strip_marker() helper), and added plan-format.md documentation plus a dedicated Case 10 test asserting the following field's own indented sub-bullets do not leak into the harvest as bogus paths.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — widened grammar tolerance for the list-item-wrapped field form; see plan-format.md and the harvester's own header comment)*
